body.name: Legal hazard-lift fiber
body.construction: \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{legal}}\) is the set of matrices \(J\) for which some invertible change of coordinates makes \(\bar v\) the all-ones vector, every \(\bar B_a\) a nonnegative emission diagonal summing to \(I_K\), \(J\) an interior diagonal hazard, \(\bar\alpha\) a probability row, \((I_K-J)^{-1}\bar K_0\) a nonnegative stochastic matrix, and \(J\bar v=\bar h\).
